description.value: Black Rabbit Coffee House is an independent specialty coffee shop in Kelowna, run by a 17-year industry veteran who named the cafe after her two pet rabbits rescued from a Calgary brewery patio. The shop features direct-trade Rosso Coffee Roasters beans, a full espresso bar, house-baked goods, and a retail shelf stocked with coffee products. Its personal backstory and commitment to small Canadian suppliers give it a distinct character among Kelowna cafes.

address.value: 652 Cook Road, Kelowna, British Columbia V1W 4T4, Canada

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is active (copyright 2025) and confirms Black Rabbit Coffee House at 652 Cook Road with phone 236-766-1844, though the postal code on the website (V1W 4T4) differs from OSM (V1W 3K5). The menu explicitly labels several items as vegan-friendly and gluten-free. No website content addresses bike parking, washrooms, water refill, Wi-Fi, or any other cycling-specific amenities, so those are null.
concerns: Postal code mismatch: OSM records V1W 3K5 but the business website contact page clearly states V1W 4T4. Website value used as the more likely authoritative source.

enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A real, active, publicly accessible independent coffee shop with a confirmed web presence, address, and phone. A useful stop for touring cyclists in Kelowna.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Menu lists multiple items as vegan-friendly and gluten-free: Hot Chocolate ('vegan friendly'), Big Fat Lion Carrot Cake and Date Square ('Allergen free, Vegan friendly and gluten free'), and Black Rabbit Brownie ('Allergen free, Vegan friendly and gluten free'). Milk alternatives (oat, almond) also available
